finding.title: Customer context assessed
finding.body: Specialized mode. The only tenant-defined area in the spec is Book.metadata (free-form publisher data, additionalProperties true). No metadata endpoint, modelId or custom-object API exists in the 11 operations. Other items: Customer email/phone are marked personal data; Integration.apiKey is a credential-shaped response field the select step must decide on; Order.payment is a discriminated oneOf (card/bank). Build requirement book-metadata-field-definitions and live requirement live-tenant-credential are open in context.yaml; if skipped, Book.metadata stays a JSON scalar and live is not_run.
